grounding.quote:
The goals are to reduce ambiguity, reduce
entropy, eliminate avoidable technical debt, increase refactorability,
reduce hidden authority, hidden mutation and semantic drift in realisation
code, and preserve enough evidence that later reviewers can audit,
refactor and reconstruct why the realisation took its current shape (P2,
P6).

Specification gives the global WHAT; every intermediate
traversal should have a finite, inspectable unit for reasoning,
implementation, evaluation, proof and later refactor. A module boundary is
one realisation-level tool for creating that unit; it is not the only
possible bounded traversal.

concepts.label: Bounded realisation design
concepts.definition: The profile concerns realisation design and implementation shape. Its goals are reduced ambiguity, entropy, avoidable debt, hidden authority, hidden mutation and semantic drift; increased refactorability; and preserved evidence for audit and reconstruction. Bounded intermediate traversal gives finite inspectable units for reasoning, implementation, evaluation, proof and refactor; a module boundary is one such tool.
conditions: Once the project has decided its outcomes and capabilities.

grounding.quote:
The preferred realisation shape is functionally biased (P1, P6). That means semantic meaning should live in typed carriers and
explicit transforms; imperative coordination should be subordinate to
admitted truth; side effects should be isolated to explicit boundary
modules; and mutable shared state should be minimised and justified. The
profile does not require a functional programming language; it does
require a functional design discipline.

concepts.label: Functional design discipline
concepts.definition: Functional design discipline is required, with a preferred functionally biased realisation: explicit typed carriers and transforms hold meaning, imperative coordination is subordinate to admitted truth, effects are isolated at explicit boundary modules, and mutable shared state is minimised and justified. A functional programming language is not required.
conditions: Within the profile's governed boundaries.

grounding.quote:
The core rule, with the test that a design is too imperative and too
coupled when a reader has to inspect orchestration to learn what the
system means, is stated once in
[SPEC_METHOD §2 Realisation shape](SPEC_METHOD.md#realisation-shape),
scoped to boundaries this profile governs; every rule below refines it
(P1, P6).

concepts.label: Imported realisation core rule
concepts.definition: The core realisation-shape rule is owned once by SPEC_METHOD §2. Its stated test is that a design is too imperative and coupled when a reader must inspect orchestration to learn the system's meaning. The profile's subsequent rules refine it.

profile before claiming design-method closure.

constraints.statement: Review first determines whether the boundary is an operative graph traversal. Product movement between typed asset states follows the outcome-traversal → graph-carrier → deterministic-realisation structure. If a deterministic module appears to own next work, target movement, traversal closure or the graph function being performed, the boundary should be repriced against graph execution before design-method closure.
conditions: This profile is used in a graph-execution-governed Product.

grounding.quote:
They are not optional heuristics. A
change that improves local ergonomics, test output or static-checker
output but fails one of them is not real progress under this profile.

constraints.statement: Each change should be judged against the three overriding evaluators; they are not optional heuristics. Local ergonomics, tests or static-checker improvements do not count as real progress when any evaluator fails.
constraints.uncertainty: The text combines should force with non-optional evaluator standing; both are retained without upgrading should to must.
conditions: The profile governs the boundary.
A design or implementation change is proposed.

grounding.quote:
If meaning survives by reconstruction, the
seam is not closed.

constraints.statement: Each change does not increase truth-surface count; existing duplicates/rivals should be reduced by seam-closure work. Each semantic boundary has one authoritative carrier or contract. Controllers must not reconstruct already-admitted truth; downstream surfaces must not silently rebuild source truth from raw artifacts; raw/open payloads are not trusted beyond ingress. Removing the authoritative carrier must fail closed: silent reconstruction of the same meaning demonstrates an unclosed seam.
conditions: A change affects a governed semantic boundary.

grounding.quote:
same-name but different-shape
carriers fail closed unless an explicit migration design makes the
divergence lawful; and negative tests cover structural drift, not only
missing source truth.

constraints.statement: Projection/query seam closure names the admitted carrier, runtime, event or source truth. Reconstructed catalogue, ownership, route, status or closure truth is structurally compared with the admitted source carrier before publication. Same-name/different-shape carriers otherwise fail closed. Negative tests cover structural drift as well as missing truth.
conditions: The module performs projection or query.
exceptions: A same-name, different-shape carrier divergence is lawful when an explicit migration design makes it lawful.

grounding.quote:
Each change should collapse the slice to the few real identity-bearing
carrier families (P3, P2).

constraints.statement: Each change should consolidate the slice into its few real identity-bearing carrier families: declare IACS first, keep subordinate payloads subordinate by default and avoid fragment classes/interfaces/result records created only for typing, serialisation or convenience extraction. Progress means sharper/fewer carrier families, less duplicate authority and less boundary inflation; extra wrappers, branch-local peer types and public records merely mirroring payload detail do not establish progress.
conditions: A governed change affects the slice.

grounding.quote:
The rule is the same: proof
first, enforcement second.

constraints.statement: Typing, schemas, validators, contracts and codecs lock in an already-real seam. Parse, validate or construct first; explicitly admit and narrow; then enforce the proved shape with types/schemas. Relabelling an open payload, enveloping loose data without changing the authority path, casts, unchecked assertions and dynamic mutation do not supply closure. The evaluator is language-agnostic; strict Python checking, sealed algebraic types with schema parsing and compiler-enforced sums with decoding are examples, not a language mandate.

grounding.quote:
The required
shape: receive foreign input; parse, validate or normalise it once;
construct local admitted carrier truth; consume only that local truth in
semantic kernels.

constraints.statement: Such input is lawful only at ingress and, once admitted, immediately becomes local carrier truth before semantic transforms. Required order: receive; parse/validate/normalise once; construct admitted local truth; consume only that truth in semantic kernels. Repeated parsing across modules, from_dict(...).to_dict() ceremony retaining open authority, loaders merely relabelling unvalidated JSON/maps and kernels inspecting open fragments are not lawful seam closure.
conditions: Input is foreign, dynamic or weakly typed.

grounding.quote:
Both lists bind. A project that adopts this profile prefers the first
and avoids the second as an obligation of the profile, not as a
description of practice:

constraints.statement: Binding preferences are immutable carriers over shared mutable objects; closed typed carriers over dictionaries/string protocols; one ingress parse/admission; explicit returns over hidden mutation; explicit failure carriers over ambient exception control where practical; small-transform composition over long controllers. Binding avoidances are a giant mutable workspace, orchestration owning semantic law, hidden coupling through globals/registries/service state, typed envelopes over open truth, dynamic semantic-centre mutation, helpers both deciding meaning and writing, and proxy interfaces retaining old authority. An avoided shape or forgone preference is nonconformant unless a profile rule permits departure and its required justification is recorded. Convenience permits none; preserve preference/avoidance modality rather than recasting every preference as an unconditional ban.
constraints.uncertainty: Full mutation-justification requirements are in an unsupplied owning clause.
conditions: A project adopts this profile.
exceptions: Materially necessary mutable carrier state is allowed under the owning Immutable carriers rule and its required recorded justification.
The explicit failure-carrier preference applies only where practical.

grounding.quote:
every function, method and
callable surface has explicit parameter and return annotations; semantic
carriers are closed and typed; and repo-authored tests, scripts and
support code are typed too, with no lower bar than production code.

constraints.statement: All repo-authored Python, including every callable, test, script and support surface, has explicit parameter/return annotations and closed typed semantic carriers. Untyped def, implicit Any, semantic dict[str, Any]/Mapping[str, Any]/object carrier truth and unchecked JSON passed through layers with .get chains are not typed semantic design; semantic-centre dict[str, Any] is design debt. Use dataclass, TypedDict, Protocol, Literal, Enum or other closed forms; validate dynamic input and narrow it before transforms. A strict pass such as mypy --strict or an equivalent configuration is required. If the adopted boundary cannot check cleanly, it is not yet implementation-conformant.
conditions: The profile governs a Python boundary.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary derives its
semantic model from one accepted Ontology (P1, P6).

Unaffected
maintenance and unrelated boundaries do not freeze merely because one
source digest changed (P2, P0).

constraints.statement: Derive the semantic model from one accepted Ontology. Before promoting a changed entity, function, authority, effect, Prime-conformant carrier, module boundary, public operation or schema, produce a candidate slice and carry it through acceptance. Identify constitutional sources and accepting design authority, stable element/relation identities and a version/basis making source change, staleness and affected projections decidable. A governing-source reprice invalidates only affected relations/projections until impact reevaluation. Publish only affected semantic/structural deltas and projection impacts; unrelated maintenance does not freeze on a digest change. Code, tests, generated schemas and an implementing agent cannot self-ratify missing authority. Inventories of classes, schemas, endpoints, commands or carriers alone are not Ontologies.
conditions: A new or materially changed active semantic boundary is involved.
exceptions: A realization_refactor wholly inside an accepted boundary may cite the existing Ontology/design basis and prove no Ontology delta; unchanged evidence need not be re-authored or re-accepted.

grounding.quote: Co-evolution is lawful only when `decision_complete(B)` holds:

constraints.statement: Neither co-evolution nor design-gated sequencing is a global default. Proportionality selects material relations and the smallest affected gate; decision completeness tests admissibility. Design, implementation and tests may co-evolve only when decision-complete, with design owning HOW and reconciliation before promotion/closure. Prior acceptance is required before retained implementation would establish unresolved/contradictory relations or choose materially non-equivalent networks with durable consequences. A symbolic contraction's removed code/runtime/test/review/reconciliation space is counterfactual evidence, not an independent gate justification. A prior gate is warranted when semantic ambiguity concerning materially different durable architectures is removed and that contraction justifies reasoning load; it is disproportionate when no materially divergent alternative remains. Record the selected relation and basis in the existing work/design carrier, with no separate artifact required. Design still records and owns HOW before promotion/closure.
conditions: Design sequencing is selected for a governed boundary.
exceptions: A disposable spike may provide evidence before acceptance without becoming the selected design.

grounding.quote:
Repeated or
cross-cutting material surprises are evidence for diagnosis under
[ACTIVATION §1 Feedback and diagnosis](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation),
not a diagnosis.

constraints.statement: Implementation can counterexample, falsify constraints or expose ambiguity, but cannot select missing semantic answers, rewrite upstream truth to legalise itself or ratify decisions after establishing them. Newly exposed architectural ambiguity switches the smallest causally closed affected decision set to design-gated sequencing without retroactively invalidating unrelated work. Serial repairs are not acceptance. Repeated/cross-cutting surprises warrant diagnosis, not automatic reframing: a diagnosed underconstrained cut triggers one bounded design_reframe, with retained code provisional until acceptance; where accepted design is decision-complete and only realisation deviates, repair is realization_refactor regardless of recurrence.
conditions: Implementation supplies design feedback.

grounding.quote:
Contradictory projections make the
design unsatisfiable and block promotion (P1, P5):

constraints.statement: Readiness for retained implementation without a prior gate holds exactly when decision-complete; a gate unable to reach it has not closed. Ontology, Prime contraction, IACS, target design, three views, public contracts, module boundaries, implementation and tests project one network at different reasoning altitudes. Their presence, names, plausibility or mechanical validity do not prove completeness. False decision_complete means underconstrained, including new semantic decisions forced into implementation, projection contradictions or multiple materially non-equivalent networks. Contradictions make design unsatisfiable and block promotion as a gate precondition, not a review-finding disposition. Existing Ontology/algebra/mappings/views may jointly carry the complete network without another document.
conditions: Decision completeness or design-gate readiness is assessed.

grounding.quote:
A result that changes a governing relation re-enters at that
relation before acceptance

constraints.statement: Declare all five frame items. Evaluate the result against every affected governing frame, preserve every applicable accepted relation and update only affected subordinate projections. Local action conserves governing truth; changed governing relations re-enter their own locus before acceptance. Open a subordinate frame only for a material distinction unresolved at governing altitude. Declared seams make the bounded set testable under ACTIVATION's seam law without a closure algorithm or recursive expansion through irrelevant relations. Local validity does not satisfy the law if any affected governing invariant is violated, duplicated or silently reinterpreted.
constraints.uncertainty: The supplied reconstruction clause distinguishes explicitly disposed duplication from unlawful undisposed duplication.
conditions: A bounded local action affects a material design frame.

grounding.quote:
constitutional functionality
  -> candidate Ontology
  -> logical completeness
  -> whole-family Prime contraction
  -> accepted Ontology basis
  -> Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set
  -> target design and domain, sequence and state projections
  -> public contract and adapter projections
  -> implementation and test projections

constraints.statement: A discovered verb, screen action, endpoint, command, ticket phrase or use case is behavioural evidence, not an architectural operation. It must not directly become public operation identity, peer carrier, module or implementation function. Preserve the declared order: constitutional functionality → candidate Ontology → logical completeness → whole-family Prime contraction → accepted Ontology basis → IACS → target design and domain/sequence/state projections → public-contract/adapter projections → implementation/test projections.
conditions: Functionality is discovered.

grounding.quote:
A missing
substrate capability remains an explicit design gap or triggers lawful
re-entry

constraints.statement: Semantic coherence does not make the design acceptable if the substrate cannot natively construct any required identity, relation, transition, authority boundary, effect, lifecycle, composition, publication or retirement behaviour. Keep the missing capability as an explicit design gap or lawful re-entry; reference bridges, adapters, filesystem runners, test doubles and promised features cannot hide it. The consumer chooses substrate and evidence mechanism.
conditions: The chosen substrate lacks a required native capability.

grounding.quote:
It
is mandatory for material algorithms, common mechanics, new dependencies
and locally rebuilt foundation capabilities.

constraints.statement: Perform a proportional selection pass under Shared machinery law. First describe capability without Product/domain/module/vendor/file/incumbent labels. Separate irreducible semantic or authority relations, retaining owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis and material lifecycle/refusal invariants, from supporting mechanics/foundations or explicitly assigned roles; factoring concerns relations and roles, not authorship. Evaluate applicable compositions from admitted project foundations; language/runtime/platform/standard library; accepted predecessor or immutable-lineage evidence; maintained external foundations where dependencies are permitted; and bounded local implementation. Re-enter recursively for newly exposed material generic subproblems before retaining them. This prior pass is distinct from post-pattern recurrence review.
conditions: Before constructing a material generic capability, common mechanic or algorithm, selecting a material dependency, or retaining implementation of a newly exposed material generic subproblem.
exceptions: No package survey or ledger is required for a trivial helper whose choice cannot materially affect authority, Product behaviour, lifecycle cost or accepted design network.

grounding.quote:
Candidate discovery is bounded, reproducible and explicitly
non-exhaustive.

constraints.statement: For every candidate category record searched sources/collections, cutoff time, relevant version basis, applicability/inclusion criteria, material exclusions, predecessor/incumbent status, discovered candidates and residual unknowns. An unsearched category records reasoned not_applicable or a named gap. Discovery closes only on its declared basis/cutoff. A gap capable of materially altering the frontier prevents selection. A later applicable candidate that could materially alter the lawful frontier invalidates affected selection evidence and re-enters selection as newly acquired material evidence.
conditions: A bounded candidate population is discovered.
exceptions: An immaterial residual may remain when the record explains why it cannot change the decision.

grounding.quote:
Unknown evidence
remains unknown and cannot be converted into a favourable score. A
universal scalar is not required.

constraints.statement: Selection does not decide bounded evolution versus fundamental re-adoption or override SPEC_METHOD's rebuttable migration presumption; a working predecessor may constrain the migration candidate set. Discovery may start with incumbents, but selection has no source-order, familiarity, sunk-cost, local-code or dependency-count preference. Compare candidate compositions, not only packages, in one ledger/equivalent record over all decision-changing dimensions: fit/constructability; semantic or operation-authority leakage; adapter/integration/migration/deletion/future-code cost; licence/maintenance/security/upgrade/supply chain; package/runtime/startup/storage/operations cost; determinism/concurrency/failure/recovery/reconstruction/replay; proof/assurance burden; exit/replacement/reversibility. Hard authority, Product-contract, safety, security, licensing or native-constructability failure eliminates the candidate. Unknown remains unknown; no universal scalar is required. Materially incomparable lawful candidates form an explicit undominated frontier.
conditions: Material admitted candidates are compared within the Product boundary and any owner-admitted migration strategy.

grounding.quote:
A material unknown
that could reverse the relation prevents dominance and remains a gap.

constraints.statement: A lawful composition dominates another only if every material dimension is comparable or evidenced non-discriminating, it is no worse on all comparable dimensions and strictly better on at least one. A potentially reversing material unknown prevents dominance and remains a gap. Dominated candidates cannot be selected; thus a local rebuild dominated by an existing lawful composition is inadmissible. Unused feature breadth alone proves no dominance and may add lifecycle cost. The existing trade-off owner may choose an undominated lawful composition only using declared exact-Product/basis priorities and risk tolerances, recording their resolution of the frontier. Unresolved priorities leave a design gap. Fewest dependencies, smallest edit/line count or richest features are not necessary selection criteria. Each rejected material candidate records decisive evidence or falsifier; unsupported preference is not closure.
conditions: Candidate dominance or final selection is considered on the current basis.
exceptions: A previously dominated candidate may become selectable when new evidence or a material dimension invalidates that dominance relation.

grounding.quote:
Ownership belongs to the declared relation, not necessarily to locally
written code;

constraints.statement: Reuse does not automatically confer or transfer semantic, admission or other operation authority. A foundation may realise an explicitly assigned authority-bearing role only with accepted design preserving the relation's owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis and material lifecycle/refusal invariants. Capability, provenance and authorship cannot widen or remint the role. Irreducible Product/domain relations retain their owners across local, reused or composed realisation. Generic local code is lawful only when it wins the same comparison; it is not the default.
conditions: A foundation or local implementation realises a declared relation.

grounding.quote:
Every cell identifies a lawful function,
declares `not_applicable` with a reason, or names a `Gap:` or
`Unanswered:` item and owner. Silence is not logical-completeness evidence

constraints.statement: Provide the matrix or an equivalent closed representation for every applicable entity/family. Every cell names a lawful function, reasoned not_applicable, or an owned Gap:/Unanswered: item; silence is insufficient. Create may mean declaration, construction, admission or materialisation. Read should normally be typed projection of authoritative truth; update should normally be admitted transition/new version rather than in-place semantic mutation; delete should normally be retirement, revocation, decommission or supersession where identity/history must remain true.
conditions: An identity-bearing entity or independently governed value family lies in the active boundary.
exceptions: Subordinate payloads/value objects inherit owner lifecycle and authority and need no peer row unless they pass the Promotion Test.

grounding.quote:
One
owner may lawfully occupy more than one role only when the governing
authority explicitly says so; role coincidence is not inferred from
implementation convenience.

constraints.statement: Supply an authority matrix or equivalent closed representation for every such crossing. Distinguish actor/capability from admitted authority, proposal from evaluation/verification/admission/execution/projection/retirement, attribution from permission, and domain meaning from runtime effects. Multiple roles may share an owner only when governing authority explicitly permits it. Composition cannot implicitly widen admitted input/constituent/current-basis authority. Delegation, elevation, transfer and retirement authority require a named typed transition and owning admission boundary carrying, not replacing, the explicit authority decision. Projections create no authority; downstream actor labels, capability strings or payload shape cannot reconstruct an authority witness.
conditions: An Ontology function or lifecycle transition crosses a semantic, authority, admission, effect, persistence or public boundary.
exceptions: Pure subordinate helpers inherit their owning function's authority envelope and need no peer authority row unless they cross a listed boundary.

grounding.quote:
- the complete semantic commit unit and its decomposability: every
  materially distinct post-validation commit or publication boundary
  capable of exposing a subset, or a design-declared dominance or
  equivalence proof that named representative observations cover the
  complete partial-failure surface;

constraints.statement: The who-admits matrix alone is insufficient. Design evidence contains the complete relation and accepted design declares each admission owner/supported boundary; exact admission-valid basis identity, predecessor and currentness continuity through admission, including equal/coherent composite multi-owner basis; complete enclosing relation, participant identities and equality joins; refusal/effect boundaries; complete commit unit and decomposability, covering every distinct post-validation commit/publication boundary exposing a subset or a declared dominance/equivalence proof of representative coverage of the entire partial-failure surface; reconstruction with supported direct/composite/nested forms; and competing-path disposition. Bind ACTIVATION §4 admission and standing-test semantics, which remain owned there; qualification is per owner and supported boundary. Missing or downstream-invented fields/owners/boundaries, inferred basis continuity/partial-failure coverage/proof/reconstruction, or parser/helper/manufactured-refusal non-applicability falsify the obligation.
conditions: Every consequential entity-transition domain; every material admission relation.

grounding.quote:
disjoint scopes or identities are not a
counterexample

constraints.statement: Every competing path is explicitly related to the singular admission law. Equivalent paths may be constituents, replicas, replacements or deliberately independent realisations; disposition does not itself require deletion. Retaining a superseded responsibility requires a distinct supported purpose, not a label or existing test. A projection may produce a candidate, but every consequential result re-enters admission against its explicit predecessor basis; projection state is not self-authenticating evidence. The law is false when materially non-equivalent admission relations remain reachable for the same transition domain, entity identity, authority scope and predecessor basis; an equivalent competing implementation remains undisposed; or projection-triggered reaction authenticates admission from its own reconstruction.
conditions: Several paths or projections can affect admission.
exceptions: Disjoint authority scopes or entity identities are not a counterexample to singularity.

grounding.quote:
Every
retained result is reconciled into accepted design before promotion or
design-method closure. No private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint may
become an undeclared constructor

constraints.statement: Derive the smallest parameterised atomic families completing lifecycles. Variation only in entity/projection/transition kind, policy or subordinate payload should normally be a typed parameter or closed variant rather than a peer function. Every functionality row is derived by an admitted atom, derived by declared higher-order composition, deferred with owner/re-entry condition, excluded by current Product authority, or an explicit named unresolved gap. Name the governing composition/effect algebra and applicable identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws; do not hide them in controller flow. Iterative discovery of composition/effects/implementation is allowed only under co_evolution_admissible; otherwise only a disposable spike crosses unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relations before acceptance. Reconcile every retained result into accepted design before promotion/closure. No private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint becomes an undeclared constructor.
conditions: Function derivation is performed; composition-law requirements apply where higher-order behaviour exists.

grounding.quote:
An atom without a declared admitted domain remains a candidate
atom; it cannot supply Prime acceptance or Prime-conformance to a
realisation projection.

constraints.statement: Every accepted atom declares its admitted domain and governs every admitted instance within it. Later use composes/parameterises it, never locally forks, shadows, specialises or reinterprets it. An in-domain counterexample falsifies the shared atom and re-enters its design boundary, not feature-local replacement. An undeclared domain leaves the atom a candidate unable to supply Prime acceptance/conformance. One atom may project into several units and a unit may implement several atoms only with explicit mapping and no rival meaning/authority. Atomic-function Prime is not established until the complete candidate family is contracted.
conditions: A Prime atom or its realisation is proposed or used.
exceptions: An out-of-domain case may justify proposing another candidate atom for design admission.

grounding.quote:
A function-and-carrier-only pass does not
establish whole-family Prime

constraints.statement: Review every proposed identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, function, composition law, effect and closure law plus every realisation projection, not isolated atoms or only functions/carriers. Ask whether operations are typed parameters of one function, commands transitions of one entity, reads projections of one truth, implementations applications of one higher-order function; whether independent identity, authority, effect, lifecycle, reuse or public pattern-match semantics are introduced; whether all atom kinds entered contraction; whether every unit maps to accepted atoms; and whether any projection introduces/duplicates/reinterprets meaning or authority. Individually plausible functions are not Prime if one parameterised template plus closed variants carries identical meaning/authority. Contract visible recurrence during design; later recurrence review is no substitute.
conditions: Before promotion and whenever whole-family Prime is claimed.

grounding.quote: Contraction preserves root authority and every retained semantic relation.

constraints.statement: Contract each candidate atom, then the whole resulting family. Local irreducibility or unit conformance does not prove global Prime if the family duplicates identity, authority, function, lifecycle, topology, effect or projection meaning. Preserve root authority and every retained semantic relation; fewer files/functions/operations/authoring surfaces cannot compensate for a new authority source/truth path. Evidence names the complete family; each stable identity, irreducible relation, admitted domain and falsification condition; whole-family contraction relation; before/after retained meaning and authority; accepted loss; and an explicit total map from every proposed projection to accepted atoms.
conditions: Prime contraction occurs at a material semantic boundary.
exceptions: Work inside an accepted boundary cites the existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

grounding.quote:
Any intentional omission or flattening declares accepted loss and a
failure condition

constraints.statement: Each design projection identifies its Ontology source and preserved identity, relationship, lifecycle, authority, function or effect law. Intentional omissions/flattening declare accepted loss and a failure condition. Target design may add structural HOW but no rival semantics; implementation/tests trace through accepted design, never bypassing it. A public operation, sequence message, state transition, carrier or effect without trace through accepted design to accepted Ontology is ungrounded and cannot enter the active Product line.
conditions: A design or implementation projection is produced.
exceptions: Implementation branches and test expectations need not each be enumerated by the Ontology, but must preserve it and trace through requirements plus accepted design.

grounding.quote:
Typed
closure by itself is not sufficient reason to create a new top-level type.

constraints.statement: Derive Prime atoms from logically complete candidate Ontology before proposing top-level units; whole-family evidence supports Ontology acceptance, and target design/IACS/modules/functions/schemas/tests project rather than originate accepted Prime meaning. Prime conformance applies to functions, classes, carriers, top-level schema records and modules. A unit is conformant only when projecting accepted atoms without adding, duplicating or reinterpreting semantic authority; topological/effect boundaries first need accepted atoms. Size and one-to-one atom correspondence are immaterial. Typical lawful grounds include new admitted-graph topology/branch, typed transformation, effect, validation/admission or projection boundary. Units solely shortening call sites without new semantics, aggregating unrelated behaviour, renaming old interfaces, wrapping data, hiding mutation/fallback/orchestration, naming non-authoritative payload variation, exposing internal detail, cosmetically mirroring carriers or multiplying types for typing discomfort are nonconformant. Prefer composition, existing lawful functions and fewer sharper boundaries/carrier families; line-count minimisation is not the aim.
conditions: Top-level realisation units are proposed.

grounding.quote:
contraction is not
successful when it increases authority centres, maintained truth surfaces,
acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manually reconciled projections
or review burden.

constraints.statement: Apply ACTIVATION proportionality to ambiguity removed versus reasoning complexity. Review cuts, realisation units, runtime modules and work items are distinct and may map many-to-one/one-to-many; administrative convenience does not force one-to-one decomposition. Contraction is not successful if authority centres, maintained truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manual projection reconciliation or review burden increase. Evidence stays proportional to semantic change/risk; no artifact or review per concern is required.
conditions: Prime contraction and its governance cost are assessed.

grounding.quote:
If the accepted Ontology
or IACS has not been declared, the schema is not yet design-method
complete under this profile.

constraints.statement: Derive IACS from accepted Ontology before naming subordinate payloads or implementation modules; it should precede helper result shapes/internal branch details. Cite accepted Ontology and function-derivation evidence; declare IACS; map every carrier to identity/lifecycle/function/authority/effect/projection law; distinguish authoritative from downstream; default all other shapes to subordinate/private unless promoted; reconcile typed implementation before closure. Carrier role examples do not justify branch-specific payload, persistence detail, read-model row or typing-only grouping as top-level. IACS is an Ontology projection, never its replacement or the first origin of semantic meaning. Absence of declared accepted Ontology or IACS prevents schema design-method completeness. Under co-evolution, evidence/code/tests may develop together but implementation cannot self-ratify discoveries; Ontology/IACS acceptance and reconciliation precede promotion/closure. Otherwise accept the affected unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relation before retained implementation establishes it.
conditions: A schema, carrier family or typed public boundary is defined.

grounding.quote: The IACS is not numerically frozen.

constraints.statement: Revision is lawful through accepted Ontology/design re-entry. Re-derive the whole IACS and classify every addition/removal/merge/split; rerun Promotion Test and Boundary Inflation checks over the full set; update every conformance/checker subject to the declared composite relation under EVALUATION's assurance-boundary congruence and freeze/revision law; reconcile implementation before promotion/closure. A prohibition without a lawful revision path is false. Revision is false if gates cover only new carriers, assurance retains weaker/obsolete subjects or reconciliation is absent before closure.
constraints.uncertainty: The external assurance-boundary congruence and freeze/revision law is referenced, not reproduced.
conditions: A carrier is added, removed, merged or split.

grounding.quote:
The burden of proof is on
promotion; designers and reviewers should assume a candidate type stays
subordinate until an irreducible boundary is shown

constraints.statement: Justify an architectural boundary, not payload detail. Promotion is allowed only if at least one holds: authoritative source carrier; public/persisted contract; explicit public-outcome variant directly pattern-matched by consumers; reuse across several modules without semantic bleed; independent versioning/publication/admission. Promotion is unlawful for mere larger-carrier detail, one-use local field grouping, open-dictionary typing shim, private variation crossing no true interface, or cosmetic/local mirror. Without independent authority, independent reuse or direct pattern-match semantics, remain nested/private/local. Proof burden rests on promotion; designers/reviewers should presume subordination until irreducible need is shown. These grounds do not waive other Prime/IACS requirements.
conditions: A subordinate payload is proposed as a top-level class, dataclass, TypedDict, enum or named schema record.

grounding.quote:
Typed closure does not excuse Boundary
Inflation.

constraints.statement: Declare IACS, authoritative types, downstream projections, subordinate shapes and intentionally deferred promotions; a wide type inventory must distinguish IACS from subordinate payloads or it is design drift. Inflation is design debt, not progress: typing difficulty promotes payload peers, internal records become public without a new authoritative boundary, near-identical peers replace a sufficient single family, or one migration silently becomes parallel schema migrations. Typed closure supplies no excuse.
conditions: Schema work or a schema/ticket's wide type family is considered.

grounding.quote:
If a target realisation cannot show that derivation chain, it is not yet
design-method complete under this profile

constraints.statement: Name reference design surfaces; provide accepted target Ontology with disposition of reference entities/functions/lifecycle/authority/effects/projections; target design surfaces replacing/binding them; explicit preserved/reshaped/deferred/delivery-binding-demoted mapping; and target module assets including Ontology-derived IACS and three views. Demonstrate how the target boundary derives from reference design without importing incidental drift, delivery quirks, helper sprawl or accidental authority. Code comparison alone or an absent chain prevents design-method completeness.
conditions: A module boundary is reference-derived.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed semantic or typed module boundary carries
one accepted Ontology and one complete three-view Mermaid design asset
before the boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure

constraints.statement: Carry one accepted Ontology and the complete three-view asset before promotion/closure. Co-evolution may precede the gate only while its predicate holds; otherwise accept affected unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relations before retained implementation establishes them. All three views are required; a broad flowchart is no substitute. They are fidelity-checked projections, not decorative peers or independent truth surfaces.
conditions: A new or materially changed semantic or typed module boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure.
exceptions: Unchanged boundaries cite their accepted basis; local work with no material semantic-boundary delta does not recreate the gate.

grounding.quote:
The design asset cites one accepted Ontology for the active boundary and
includes or references its

constraints.statement: Include or reference entity/relationship inventory, invariant/cardinality law, lifecycle-completeness matrix, authority matrix, atomic/higher-order derivation matrix, applicable composition/effect algebra, whole-family Prime contraction with every accepted atom's domain and projection mapping, and explicit deferred/excluded/unresolved functionality. A boundary-bounded slice may derive from a wider accepted Product Ontology only with a parent citation and preservation of parent identity/relationship/lifecycle/authority/function law. Copying selected rows into an ungrounded local model creates a rival truth surface.
conditions: A design asset covers an active boundary.

grounding.quote:
Sufficiency is bound to a declared action and its affected set; it is
not a claim over an unbounded space of possible future changes, and the
performance of any particular reviewer is not evidence either way

Existing Ontology evidence, authority/admission/frame declarations, views and module mappings carry this durable reasoning state; no new package/artifact is required. Missing governing relations or inability to decide from the two inputs alone falsify sufficiency. If tested, use named cases with known governing relations/expected decisions and withhold conversational/folk-memory aids.

grounding.quote:
| preserves | leaves the relation intact and operates inside it | `satisfied` |
| changes | alters the relation itself, and therefore re-enters at that relation before acceptance | `invalid_basis` |
| duplicates | establishes an equivalent path that is explicitly disposed as a constituent, replica, replacement or deliberately independent realisation | `satisfied` |
| violates | contradicts the relation, or establishes an equivalent path that is left undisposed | `falsified` |

constraints.statement: Preserves leaves accepted relation intact and maps to satisfied. Changes alters the relation and requires re-entry at its locus before acceptance, mapping to invalid_basis. Duplicates is an equivalent path explicitly disposed as constituent/replica/replacement/deliberately independent realisation, mapping to satisfied. Violates contradicts or leaves an equivalent path undisposed, mapping to falsified. A change accepted in the acting frame instead of its owning locus is a violation regardless of delta size; disposition, not equivalence alone, separates lawful duplication from violation. Preserve the predicate, decision and core value together. If none of the four is reached, return the cause-selected core value, including indeterminate for insufficient admissible evidence and what would decide it. If the method/design pair itself is insufficient, that case falsifies the sufficiency law. A lawful re-entry change is neither an acting-frame acceptance nor a violation; a violation is not re-entry.
constraints.uncertainty: Other cause-to-core mappings are owned by the referenced result algebra.
conditions: An action is evaluated against one governing relation for admissibility in the acting frame on the current governing basis.

constraints.statement: For the exact-basis disjunction 'meets axiom OR axiom does not apply', pass maps to satisfied when cited Ontology/view/enforcement evidence establishes compliance. not_applicable maps to satisfied only when applicability is false on basis-bound facts, with a reason naming those facts and the excluding scope authority; it satisfies only the disjunction, never 'meets axiom'. Record verdict and value together. If no refined verdict is reached, record cause-selected core value and what would decide: indeterminate for insufficient admissible evidence, including unresolved applicability with unmet axiom; out_of_frame for undeclared relation/evaluator capability; invalid_basis for unsupported Ontology/design basis. Unevaluated applicable axioms have no result. None of these is pass; exclusion is neither conformance nor failure, and undecided/unevaluated is neither pass nor fail.

constraints.statement: Both Ontology and design verdicts must be accepted before affected implementation/public contract/semantic carrier promotion or closure. Any non-satisfied axiom result, applicable axiom without result, or resultless axiom whose applicability is not established false keeps non-accepted: mandatory non-satisfied results/gaps cannot combine to satisfied.
